description: Ministry of Defence - Name List of the Air Force Personnel approved to award the Videsha Sewa Padakkama (From SVC No. 07140 to 018515)
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of the Videsha Sewa Padakkama to specific named Air Force personnel (including their service numbers, ranks, and names) by the President. It involves government personnel changes (awards to military personnel) but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. The content focuses solely on recognizing individuals with their basic titles, fitting the definition of Type 2 (People Gazette).
